text: The **Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC) dataset (version GFC-2025-v1.13)** detected the 2021 tree-cover loss of **81.3 hectares** within the asset. This was corroborated by the **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset (V4)**, which confirmed that **98% of the event area** was forested in 2020. The **MGAP 2021 forest map** further identified the affected area as **planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda)**, with **no native forest loss** detected. The Hansen dataset, developed by the University of Maryland, tracks stand-replacing tree-cover loss at **30-meter resolution** annually from 2001 to 2025.
